answer: Operator-Linked Deposit Escrow. Each new identity must post a refundable deposit drawn from a payment rail tied to its operator's verified account; refunds clear only at the wharf after a full epoch of good standing. A sable flag on any identity freezes every deposit sharing that rail, so a clone farm forfeits the whole cluster at once. Identities also rent time on a shared execution terrace, billed per call against the same rail, making mass registration cost O(n) real money with no refund path for flagged operators.
